parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The type of the tag key. Valid values:
- **Custom**: a user-added tag key.
- **System**: a system-created tag key.

> If this parameter is left empty, all tag keys are returned by default.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description:
The key of the tag.
> This parameter is required.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Specifies the page to return when a tag key has multiple tag values. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. This parameter is typically used together with PageSize. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of tag values to return per page when a tag key has multiple tag values. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance ID.

> If this parameter is left empty, all tag values of the specified tag key for the current account are returned.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type defined by the system. Set the value to **ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE**.
